authorial_core.source_request: 시각 의미 데이터와 후보 데이터에 반영해줘. 그 다음 스킬의 최신 버전을 사용하여 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 이번에 반영한 주제가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 주제에 어울리는 랜덤한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
authorial_core.interpreted_intent: The requester asks for independent random mecha/robot qualification concepts with the supplied portrait. Mecha means visibly articulated robotic equipment rather than general futuristic styling. At saved creativity 1 I compared an isolated equipment demonstration with an inhabited repair moment; I chose a rooftop greenhouse worker controlling a storm-bent cabinet door just as its load settles onto a trestle. The wind, incomplete hinge alignment and supported door make her effort understandable. This task, location, ochre coverall, pose, camera and mechanical arrangement are replaceable authorial staging, not requester-owned anchors. Sensual 1 supports a quiet personal warmth in her concentration; fetish 0, surreal 0 and trend off add no treatment. The supplied image governs visible facial/hair appearance only; its clothing/background and any inferred personality are not reference requirements. A right-side articulated support and handle contact are planned at enough scale to review together without inventing a required mechanical contract before retrieval.
authorial_core.subject: A woman using wearable robotic field equipment, with face and hair guided by the supplied portrait.
authorial_core.setting: Wind-battered rooftop greenhouse service deck after a storm.
authorial_core.event: The cabinet door load has settled onto a trestle while the worker steadies it and checks the hinge.
visual_priorities: The woman, exoskeleton arm and storm-bent cabinet door form one readable working relationship.
The arm follows a plausible shoulder-to-cuff chain while her hand remains connected to the handle.
The face and dark bob preserve the supplied appearance in a concentrated working portrait.
Wet glass, bowed plants and supported door make the pause after a gust visible.
authorial_core.baseline_prompt_en: A cinematic documentary photograph of a woman wearing wearable robotic equipment, caught in field work with robotic equipment on the service deck of a wind-battered rooftop greenhouse. Use the supplied reference for her visible facial appearance and dark bob haircut. Her face keeps the reference's soft oval shape, dark eyes and fine wispy fringe; wind lifts a few short strands across one cheek. Her quiet concentration and relaxed mouth give the working portrait a subtle personal warmth. A heavy relay-cabinet door has been bent by the storm. Its lower edge has just settled onto a low maintenance trestle while she holds its outer handle steady, keeping a wind-blown door from swinging back across her work. The open cabinet and its displaced hinge bracket remain immediately behind the door; one loose fastener and a short wrench rest on the trestle beside the lower corner. She is checking the upper hinge alignment, with her left fingertips placed on the cabinet-side hinge bracket. Her right hand encloses the door handle, her right elbow bent naturally. An articulated utility exoskeleton follows the outside of that right arm, with a padded upper-arm cuff, an elbow pivot, a forearm cuff and a shoulder support attached to a fitted torso harness. The right-arm assembly and her human wrist remain visually distinct. Her boots are planted apart on the wet nonslip deck, and the trestle carries the door's lower edge. She wears a weathered ochre work coverall, its functional waist and rolled cuffs following her movement. Broken cloud gives soft directional daylight, a warmer sunbreak briefly touching her cheek and the pale aluminum links. Wet greenhouse glass and rows of bowed green plants give the gust a visible consequence in the background. A close full-length vertical photograph from her front-right, with enough depth of field to keep her face, the complete arm support, the handle and both door hinges readable together. Real skin and work-worn mechanical surfaces, restrained color, a particular task caught in progress.
